name: computer
description: Open-source computer use for AI agents — control a Mac with Anthropic or OpenAI. CLI + MCP server + REST API + SDK; sessions and action logs are stored in SQLite at ~/.hasna/computer/computer.db by default, and HASNA_COMPUTER_DATABASE_URL selects PostgreSQL via the storage-sync adapter.

serviceSurfaces.name: computer-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: computer-serve exposes GET /health but not GET /ready or GET /version; the supported-API topology (health, readiness, version) is not yet implemented
